scenario_name: MetaGPT-style SOP-Governed Procurement Approval — Case 5 for AgentCoordKG
description: Hand-authored scenario following MetaGPT's real Role/Environment/Message/SOP schema (confirmed via official MetaGPT documentation), NOT a live MetaGPT run. Demonstrates AgentCoordKG's coverage of the fifth and final framework studied, including a fourth independent confirmation that a framework's orchestration primitive (here, SOP) maps onto dependsOn, and a third confirmation that Environment is a genuinely shared concept with HarnessKG (this time using MetaGPT's identically-named Environment/Message primitives, the strongest direct terminological match found in this framework study, mirroring the same finding in HarnessKG's MetaGPT scenario).

_metagpt_native_log._comment: Mimics a real MetaGPT multi-role procurement team governed by an SOP, using MetaGPT's actual concepts (Role, Environment, Message publish/observe, SOP-defined execution order). Not itself part of the RDF instance data.

sop.description: BudgetAuditor's action must not begin until ProcurementOfficer's action publishes its output Message

environment.description: Shared space where Roles observe and publish_message

run_trace.output_message: Audit failed: order exceeds quarterly budget allocation

_mapping_decision_tree_notes.Role (LLM + Observation + Thought + Acti: Maps directly to ak:Agent -- no ontology change needed.
_mapping_decision_tree_notes.Environment (shared space for observe/pu: Maps directly to ak:Environment -- MetaGPT's own term and definition match nearly verbatim, the strongest direct terminological match found in this framework study, mirroring the identical finding in HarnessKG's own MetaGPT scenario (Environment is confirmed as a genuinely shared concept across both companion ontologies from a third independent angle).
_mapping_decision_tree_notes.SOP (Standard Operating Procedure, const: FOURTH INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION: maps directly to dependsOn (Task -> Task) -- BudgetAuditor's task cannot begin until ProcurementOfficer's task completes and publishes output. This is the fourth framework (after CrewAI's Process, AutoGen's GroupChatManager, LangGraph's Edge) whose native orchestration primitive lands cleanly on AgentCoordKG's dependsOn, providing strong convergent evidence that dependsOn is a genuinely framework-agnostic coordination relation.
_mapping_decision_tree_notes.Memory (stores past experiences for lear: NO AgentCoordKG equivalent -- third independent confirmation (after CrewAI's Crew.memory=True and LangGraph's State/Checkpointer) that a framework's memory-flavored primitive belongs entirely to HarnessKG, never to AgentCoordKG.
_mapping_decision_tree_notes.Action (the executed capability within _: NO separate ak:Class -- consistent with HarnessKG's MetaGPT scenario, Action is the internal mechanism producing a Message, not itself instantiated as a node.
_mapping_decision_tree_notes.Budget audit failure (BudgetAuditor's ac: Interpreted (not native to MetaGPT) as violatesConstraint -> Conflict, consistent with the interpretive pattern used across all AgentCoordKG framework scenarios.
_mapping_decision_tree_notes.Acceptance of the revised, budget-compli: Interpreted (not native to MetaGPT) as triggering ak:Decision, consistent with the task-outcome Decisions found across all five AgentCoordKG framework scenarios.
